column1: # The el8 binary packages the version map is extracted from, pinned by
# checksum. Rocky Linux 8.10 (DR-0002); none of it is vendored into the
# repository. glibc carries libc.so.6 and seven of the eight companions;
# libnsl.so.1 is its own package at glibc's own build, and libcrypt.so.1 is
# libxcrypt rather than glibc, which el8 built --disable-crypt.
